facts: Parties: Kestrel Media Ltd (Buyer), Orwell Bioscience plc (Seller); the Company is Kestrel Software Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 8 June 2026; Closing is scheduled for 29 August 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 8 June 2026), either party may terminate.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Holloway Foods Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 20 December 2026.
